name: animations.dev
summary: Interactive course by Emil Kowalski on crafting web animations with CSS and Framer Motion (Motion).
description: animations.dev teaches the theory and practice of UI animation: choosing easings and timing, spring animations, and coding performant animations with CSS animations and Framer Motion, with exercises on a custom-built platform. 13,000+ designers and engineers have taken it; enrollment is closed until 2027, with a waitlist that includes two free preview lessons.
contains: video lessons, breakdowns and interactive exercises on a custom platform
covers animation theory, CSS animations and Framer Motion (now Motion)
